'''Rafe Shahverdian''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[weather officer]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Shahverdian was a friend of [[Denno Yanglan]]'s, and the pair defected from the Empire along with [[Mayr Stillman]] after the [[Battle of Bakura]].<ref name="Sourcebook" />
